description: Execute a command as another user.

tip: Stop processing command line arguments.

option.name: --askpass
tip: Use a helper program for password prompting.

option.name: --background
tip: Run command in the background.

option.name: --bell
tip: Ring bell when prompting.

option.name: --chdir
tip: Change the working directory before running command.

option.name: --chroot
tip: Change the root directory before running command.

option.name: --close-from
tip: Close all file descriptors >= NUM.

option.name: --command-timeout
tip: Terminate command after the specified time limit.

option.name: --edit
tip: Edit files instead of running a command.

option.name: --group
tip: Run command as the specified group name or ID.

option.name: --host
tip: Run command on host (if supported by plugin).

option.name: --list
tip: List user's privileges or check a specific command.
Use twice for longer format.

option.name: --login
tip: Run login shell as the target user; a command may also be specified.

option.name: --non-interactive
tip: Non-interactive mode, no prompts are used.

option.name: --other-user
tip: In list mode, display privileges for user.

option.name: --preserve-env
tip: Preserve user environment when running command.
With a list value, preserve only the specified environment variables.

option.name: --preserve-groups
tip: Preserve group vector instead of setting to target's.

option.name: --prompt
tip: Use the specified password prompt.

option.name: --remove-timestamp
tip: Remove timestamp file completely.

option.name: --reset-timestamp
tip: Invalidate timestamp file.

option.name: --role
tip: Create SELinux security context with specified role.

option.name: --set-home
tip: Set HOME variable to target user's home dir.

option.name: --shell
tip: Run shell as the target user; a command may also be specified.

option.name: --stdin
tip: Read password from standard input.

option.name: --type
tip: Create SELinux security context with specified type.

option.name: --user
tip: Run command (or edit file) as specified user name or ID.

option.name: --validate
tip: Update user's timestamp without running a command.

global_option.name: --help
tip: Display help message and exit.

global_option.name: --version
tip: Display version information and exit.
